correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and the Frobenius metric are explicit for n>=3 with independent uniform incident edges sampled with replacement. The single-cycle generator count is exact. Conditional fixed sets give the exact prescribed-arrow factorial moment (q)_j/(n-t-1)_j for fixed j<n-s; since q=n+O(s+t), bounded deficits force a unit-Poisson limit. The intersection of random fixed sets vanishes, establishing asymptotic independence of all three counts. Exact matrix traces, Taylor expansion of the normalized inner product and the delta method yield angle fluctuations with variance 1/2. The embedded checker confirms matrix and factorial-moment identities exhaustively through n=6; simulation at n=100 is only a sanity check, not the proof.

value.rationale: The result supplies an explicit local Euclidean tangent-angle law for an infinite classical family of high-dimensional transportation polytopes. Although the number of incident edges grows factorially, a random pair becomes asymptotically 60-degree and has a sharply determined non-Gaussian microscopic correction; this cannot be read off from degree, edge counts, or small-dimensional Frobenius tables. The whole family and all local edge pairs are treated with one natural sampling law and a substantive cycle-overlap lemma, avoiding arbitrary finite slices.
